title: VLMine: Long-Tail Data Mining with Vision Language Models
mechanism: Mine rare examples from an unlabelled corpus by rank-combining multiple signals (VLM keyword rarity, model uncertainty).
adaptation: Replace VLM signal (no EL knowledge) with ensemble-predicted inactive fraction, ensemble disagreement and embedding novelty vs train; mine the 159k pool for inactive-rich and half-cut scuff cells, pseudo-label only those.
min_experiment: Arm: house + 500 mined inactive-rich pseudo-labelled cells. Baseline: house 5 seeds. Metric: CV and clean-49 inactive IoU, BMRK inactive, E1 inactive. Kill: < +0.02 inactive IoU on CV folds.
evidence: R: 10-50% gains over mining baselines on ImageNet-LT, Places-LT, Waymo.
prior_overlap: Pool SSL used pool without targeted mining (n.d.). Partly open.
